summary: Kadant is a well-capitalized industrial roll-up running into a genuine capital-equipment cyclical slowdown. No going-concern, restatement, auditor-change, or covenant-distress signature; KPMG since 2012 with clean ICFR; leverage 0.99x vs 3.75x covenant; $134M FCF; three small-mid tuck-in acquisitions in 2024 all appear arm's-length with sensible PPAs. Two real Mode B catches: (1) total backlog -17% YoY and Industrial Processing backlog -31% YoY with organic bookings -5% — the 'record bookings' headline is acquisition-driven and capital demand is decelerating, with Q1 25 confirming the trend amid tariff-related capex deferrals; (2) CEO Powell sold $3.2M of stock in Sep 2024 at $320-324 and CFO McKenney sold $2.97M in Feb 2025 at $368-377 — both code-S open-market, both explicitly NOT under 10b5-1 plans — with zero offsetting insider buys. Combined with $479M of goodwill assessed via Step-0 qualitative test before the bookings/tariff/share-price deterioration, the picture is of an honestly-disclosed but slowing roll-up where the two most senior insiders monetized at the local peaks. Mostly honest, with material organic-deterioration and insider-distribution signals.
